guide_descAllSequences: Four sequences and any pair; no pungs or kongs.
guide_descSeatWind: A pung or kong of your own seat wind.
guide_descPrevailingWind: A pung or kong of the prevailing wind. Stacks with seat wind on the same pung.
guide_descDragonPung: A pung or kong of any dragon. Each dragon pung counts separately.
guide_descSeatFlower: 1 faan for each flower or season tile matching your seat number.
guide_descNoFlowers: Win without holding any flower or season tile.
guide_descSelfDraw: Win on a tile you drew yourself.
guide_descFullyConcealed: No open melds and no concealed kong; stacks with self-draw.
guide_descChickenHand: A winning hand worth no other faan, scoring 0. Only possible when the table minimum is 0.
guide_descWinOnLastWallTile: Win by drawing the very last tile of the wall.
guide_descWinOnKongReplacement: Win on the replacement tile drawn after declaring a kong.
guide_descChainedKong: Win on the replacement tile after a kong that itself followed a kong; replaces Kong Replacement and Self-Draw.
guide_descRobbingTheKong: Win on the tile another player adds to a pung to make a kong.
guide_descAllPungs: Four pungs or kongs and a pair; no sequences.
guide_descHalfFlush: Tiles from one suit plus honors.
guide_descSmallThreeDragons: Pungs of two dragons and a pair of the third.
guide_descMixedTerminals: Only terminals and honors, with both present; replaces All Pungs.
guide_descFlowerSet: All four flowers, or all four seasons; 2 faan per set, replacing those tiles' Seat Flower faan.
guide_descSevenPairs: Seven different pairs; no Fully Concealed on top.
guide_descSmallFourWinds: Pungs of three winds and a pair of the fourth.
guide_descFullFlush: Tiles from one suit only, no honors.
guide_descBigThreeDragons: Pungs or kongs of all three dragons.
guide_descBigFourWinds: Pungs or kongs of all four winds.
guide_descThirteenOrphans: One of each terminal and honor, plus one duplicate of any of them.
guide_descAllTerminals: Only 1s and 9s of the numbered suits.
guide_descNineGates: One suit, fully concealed, 1112345678999 plus any one more tile of that suit.
guide_descHeavenlyHand: The dealer wins on the initial deal, before any discard.
guide_descEarthlyHand: A non-dealer wins on the dealer's first discard.
guide_descFourConcealedPungs: Four concealed pungs or kongs; the winning tile must not complete a pung by claim.
coachMarks_discardTwoStep: Tap a tile in your hand to lift it, then tap it again to discard it.
coachMarks_discardOneTap: Tap a tile in your hand to discard it.
coachMarks_lastDiscard: The newest discard pulses in the middle of the table. It is the one players can claim.
coachMarks_claims: When you can claim a discard, big buttons pop up over the table. Pick one, or pass.
